title: Bioinformatics Approaches for Understanding the Binding Affinity of Protein-Nucleic Acid Complexes.
authors: Harini, K; Sekijima, Masakazu; Gromiha, M Michael
one_liner_zh: 该综述系统总结了蛋白质-核酸复合物结合亲和力的生物信息学数据库与预测工具，虽涵盖TF-DNA相关体系，但以宽泛综述为主，缺乏具体AI/物理模拟方法创新，对本课题有参考价值。
abstract: Protein-nucleic acid interactions are involved in various biological processes such as gene expression, replication, transcription, translation, and packaging. Understanding the recognition mechanism of the protein-nucleic acid complexes has been investigated from different perspectives, including the binding affinities of protein-DNA and protein-RNA complexes. Experimentally, protein-nucleic acid interactions are analyzed using X-ray crystallography, Isothermal Titration Calorimetry (ITC), DNA/RNA pull-down assays, DNA/RNA footprinting, and systematic evolution of ligands by exponential enrichment (SELEX). On the other hand, numerous databases and computational tools have been developed to study protein-nucleic acid complexes based on their binding sites, specific interactions between them, and binding affinity. In this chapter, we discuss various databases for protein-nucleic acid complex structures and the tools available to extract features from them. Further, we provide details on databases and prediction methods reported for exploring the binding affinity of protein-nucleic acid complexes along with important structure-based parameters, which govern the binding affinity.
abstract_zh: 蛋白质-核酸相互作用涉及多种生物过程，如基因表达、复制、转录、翻译和包装。理解蛋白质-核酸复合物的识别机制已从不同角度进行了研究，包括蛋白质-DNA和蛋白质-RNA复合物的结合亲和力。在实验上，蛋白质-核酸相互作用通过X射线晶体学、等温滴定量热法（ITC）、DNA/RNA下拉实验、DNA/RNA足迹分析和指数富集配体系统进化（SELEX）进行分析。另一方面，已开发出众多数据库和计算工具，用于基于结合位点、它们之间的特异性相互作用以及结合亲和力来研究蛋白质-核酸复合物。在本章中，我们讨论了用于蛋白质-核酸复合物结构的各种数据库以及从中提取特征的可用工具。此外，我们详细介绍了用于探索蛋白质-核酸复合物结合亲和力的数据库和预测方法，以及控制结合亲和力的重要基于结构的参数。
